additionalRules: Friendly Dwarf models gain the Erebor keyword.

specialRules.name: Wall of Steel
specialRules.text: Friendly models that are Supporting gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: "For Erebor!"
specialRules.text: Each friendly Hero model may, once per game, declare a Heroic Combat for free.

specialRules.name: Like Father, Like Son
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of each other, Gimli and Glóin may re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes.

units.name: Dain Ironfoot, King Under the Mountain

specialRules.name: Barazantathul
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Master-forged two-handed weapon.

specialRules.name: King Under the Mountain
specialRules.text: Dáin's Stand Fast covers the entire battlefield regardless of range. Friendly Erebor Dwarf Hero models may benefit from Dáin's Stand Fast.

specialRules.name: Venerable
specialRules.text: Whenever Dáin has to take a Jump, Climb or Leap Test, he rolls two D6 and chooses the lowest result.

units.name: Dwalin the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Sworn Protector (Thorin)
specialRules.text: Whilst Thorin is alive and on the battlefield, this model passes all Courage tests.

specialRules.name: Grasper & Keeper
specialRules.text: Unique hand weapons. +1 Attacks when using them, and unprevented natural 6s To Wound deal 2 Wounds rather than 1.

specialRules.name: Weapon Master
specialRules.text: Dwalin is never considered Unarmed.

specialRules.name: The King's Axemen
specialRules.text: At the start of a Combat within 3" of Thorin, Dwalin may use this rule: +1 Strength on a Strike if he wins the Duel Roll, but -D3 Defence until the end of the Combat if he loses it.

specialRules.name: Dwarven Lords
specialRules.text: A Dwarf King takes the Faction Keyword of the most common Dwarf type in the army and gains a matching bonus; in an Erebor-majority army (as here) he gains the Ancient Enemies (Orc) special rule.

specialRules.name: Cold-headed
specialRules.text: Whenever Thorin declares a Heroic Action, roll a D6; on a 5+ it is free and no Might is spent. If an enemy then declares a Heroic Action, Thorin may change the type of Heroic Action he declared.

units.name: Bifur the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Sworn Protector (Thorin)
specialRules.text: Whilst Thorin is alive and on the battlefield, this model passes all Courage tests.

specialRules.name: Embedded Axe
specialRules.text: If Bifur wins a Duel Roll he may headbutt a chosen enemy model (Strength 4 Strike, not doubled if Trapped) instead of making Strikes. Once it Wounds, Bifur gains a free Heroic Move each turn he passes an Intelligence Test.

units.name: Bofur the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Sworn Protector (Thorin)
specialRules.text: Whilst Thorin is alive and on the battlefield, this model passes all Courage tests.

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.text: A friendly Erebor Hero within 3" of Bofur affected by an enemy special rule or Magical Power may roll a D6; on a 3+ they ignore its effects.

units.name: Dori the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Sworn Protector (Thorin)
specialRules.text: Whilst Thorin is alive and on the battlefield, this model passes all Courage tests.

specialRules.name: A Good Sort
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of either Ori or Nori, Dori increases his Attacks to 3 and may re-roll rolls of 1 in his Duel rolls.

units.name: Gloin the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Sworn Protector (Thorin)
specialRules.text: Whilst Thorin is alive and on the battlefield, this model passes all Courage tests.

specialRules.name: Axe Mastery
specialRules.text: If Glóin is outnumbered in a Combat, he increases his Attacks to 4 for the duration of the Combat.

units.name: Iron Hills Captain
options: Exchange Shield and Spear for Mattock - Free

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: Two-handed weapon. On winning a Duel Roll, may attempt to knock the target Prone (opposed Strength+D6 roll) instead of Striking.

units.name: Nori the Dwarf, Champion of Erebor

specialRules.name: Sworn Protector (Thorin)
specialRules.text: Whilst Thorin is alive and on the battlefield, this model passes all Courage tests.

specialRules.name: Weapon Master
specialRules.text: Nori is never considered Unarmed.

specialRules.name: "Just a couple of keepsakes"
specialRules.text: Whilst carrying an Objective, Nori may re-roll all failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes, but may never pass the Objective to a friendly model.

units.name: Iron Hills Goat Rider
options: Exchange War Spear for Mattock - Free

specialRules.name: Devastating Charge
specialRules.text: When this model Charges one or more 25mm-based models, roll a D6 for each; on a 5+ that model is immediately knocked Prone.

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: Two-handed weapon. On winning a Duel Roll, may attempt to knock the target Prone (opposed Strength+D6 roll) instead of Striking.
